items.signal_prefix: Colloidal silica capacity: Kashima [I] line in full operation

set.signal: Colloidal silica capacity: Kashima [I] line in full operation; Kyoto new line completed certification; Kashima [II] construction completed in August 2025 with certification currently in progress. Next expansion: Kyoto site ultra-high-purity colloidal silica capacity scheduled for completion in Feb. 2029 at 1.2 x current capacity, planned investment JPY 40 billion. High-concentration, high-productivity products raise silica particles per unit volume by approximately 1.5 times.

items.reason: The deck says only 'Certification currently in progress' for Kashima [II]; 'customer' certification was added by the enricher.
